contents.text: How much cash did Netflix spend repurchasing its common stock in 2025?

Netflix repurchased 86,536,215 shares of common stock for an aggregate amount of $9.1 billion in 2025 (Source: NFLX-10K-2025.html, PART II > Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations).
